'''Upper Markaran Outpost''', originally '''Remote Markaran Outpost''', was an outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] located in the [[Markaran Plains]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonels]] [[Proshen]] and [[Teeg]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Moriden]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaggard]], and [[Intelligence officer/Legends|Intelligence Officer]] [[Kytoma]] were stationed at the outpost. It was later taken over by the [[Balmorran resistance]], with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jolis]], [[Feero]], and [[I-M3]] stationed there.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the mission log for the mission "Biohazard," the outpost is mistakenly labeled as the "Troida Observation Outpost," despite the [[Troida Military Workshop]] being located in the [[Gorinth Canyon]].
